digest.component_or_area: plan review criterion and container pass
propositions: Acceptance criteria across a plan and its children can be mutually unsatisfiable without triggering a finding until late in implementation because no Pass-1 criterion owns the joint-satisfiability concern

A new single-turn advisory criterion `ac-satisfiability` in the coherence facet must detect three shapes of set-quantification contradiction: universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, and snapshot cardinality
G3's child-coverage audit cannot fire because its sibling roster carries only ids and titles, not the acceptance criteria needed to discharge the test that no sibling covers each parent criterion

The sibling roster is built independently in three places (pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, eval_solver.py) and must be single-sourced via a shared `build_sibling_roster` helper to prevent divergence between production and eval harnesses

The roster must be moved from per-pairing instructions into the system prompt as a byte-stable prefix, and its token cost must be counted in the parent_tokens estimate for bin-packing and cache-eligibility decisions
